description: Two-seat ex-Royal Jordanian Air Force F-104B on the Madaba roundabout known locally as Dawwar al-Tayyara. Construction number 283-5010, ex USAF 57-1298. Arrived between 2001 and October 2009 and has been refurbished since. Confirmed on Esri imagery of 7 May 2025; the roundabout is separately mapped in OpenStreetMap as a historic aircraft named Dawwar al-Tayyara.
